normalization_plan.reason: _newOwner is only a temporary carrier for the owner state variable written by transferOwnership
blockNumber is only used as an argument to the getRand randomness derivation
_requestor is only used to index and validate the pendingNumbers entry created by requestNumber
_max is a transient override of the max field of pendingNumbers set by requestNumber
_waitTime is a transient override of the waitTime field of pendingNumbers set by requestNumber
_recipient is only consumed by the external transfer inside withdraw
_balance is only the amount of the external transfer inside withdraw
luckyBlock is a temporary value produced and consumed entirely within _revealNumber
luckyNumber is a temporary value produced and persisted entirely within _revealNumber
z is the transient arithmetic result local to the SafeMath helpers such as safeAdd
remainingBlocks is the transient return value computed inside _remainingBlocks
